description: Asks whether the same one-expression battery as route-ado-and-dao-battery gives the same value, tag and failure through DAO when the database is an MDB (Jet 4 format, same collation) rather than an ACCDB, plus date, rounding and text-compare expressions whose behaviour may depend on the file format, and the stored-column projections over Mx. Each expression is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-mdb is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: SELECT ID, N, T, IsNull(N) AS inN, Nz(T, 'none') AS nzT, Len(T) AS lT, N & T AS c, IIf(IsNull(T), 'null', IIf(T = '', 'empty', T)) AS cls FROM Mx ORDER BY ID
SELECT Left('abc', 2) AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT String(300, 'a') AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT CInt(1) AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT CDec(1) AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT Now() AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT 1 / 2 AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT Left(Mm, 10) AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT Mm & 'x' AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT Nz(Mm) AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT Len(Mm) AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
SELECT Format(1, '0') AS v FROM Lg WHERE ID = 1
